definitions.explanation: A transparent liquid essential for life.

examples.japanese: {冷|つめ}たい{水|みず}で{手|て}を{洗|あら}った。
examples.english: I washed my hands with cold water.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}に{水|みず}をあげるのを{忘|わす}れないでね。
examples.english: Don't forget to water the flowers.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}い{日|ひ}は{水|みず}をたくさん{飲|の}んだほうがいいですよ。
examples.english: You should drink plenty of water on hot days.

notes:
{水|みず} refers to water—the essential liquid for life, used for drinking, washing, and many other purposes.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {水|みず}を{飲|の}む: to drink water
- {水|みず}をかける: to pour water on
- {水|みず}に{流|なが}す: to let bygones be bygones (idiom)
- お{水|みず}: water (polite, often in restaurants)

COMPOUNDS:
- {水曜日|すいようび}: Wednesday
- {水道|すいどう}: water supply, tap water
- {洪水|こうずい}: flood
- {水泳|すいえい}: swimming
- {水着|みずぎ}: swimsuit
- {水分|すいぶん}: moisture, water content
- {冷水|れいすい}: cold water

CULTURAL NOTE:
{水|みず} is one of the five elements ({五行|ごぎょう}) in East Asian philosophy.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{湯|ゆ}: hot water
- {湯|ゆ}: hot water (often for bathing)
